mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the medium cubital vein, a superficial vein of the upper limb, located on the forearm."
The vein commonly used is the medium cubital vein, a superficial vein of the upper limb, located on the forearm.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is any procedure used to achieve an objective, or a set of intended action through which a goal is expected to be achieved."
A plan is any procedure used to achieve an objective, or a set of intended action through which a goal is expected to be achieved.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is defined as subjective evidence of disease perceived by the patient."
Symptom is defined as subjective evidence of disease perceived by the patient.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a general purpose centrifuge while the microhaematocrit centrifuge is designed specifically for the determination of packed cell volume (PCV) on a sample of blood collected inside a capillary tube."

The bench centrifuge is a general purpose centrifuge while the microhaematocrit centrifuge is designed specifically for the determination of packed cell volume (PCV) on a sample of blood collected inside a capillary tube.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refer to all skills and manipulations involved in the applications of scientific facts (from the natural sciences) to test procedures in the laboratory."
Laboratory Techniques refer to all skills and manipulations involved in the applications of scientific facts (from the natural sciences) to test procedures in the laboratory.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is any test that measures the level of a specific substance, or shows the relative composition of the constituent matter in a clinical specimen e.g."
A quantitative analysis is any test that measures the level of a specific substance, or shows the relative composition of the constituent matter in a clinical specimen e.g.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a test that detects the presence of a specific substance/matter, or reveal the various constituents matter of importance, in a given clinical specimen e.g."
A qualitative analysis is a test that detects the presence of a specific substance/matter, or reveal the various constituents matter of importance, in a given clinical specimen e.g.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an array of essentially qualitative analysis performed on urine for screening and diagnostic purposes."
Urinalysis is an array of essentially qualitative analysis performed on urine for screening and diagnostic purposes.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is defined as objective evidence of disease perceptible to the examining health professional."
Sign is defined as objective evidence of disease perceptible to the examining health professional.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the pH at which there is no net charge (zero charge) on protein particles."
Iso-electric point of a protein is the pH at which there is no net charge (zero charge) on protein particles.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an environment that nurtures capable, dedicated and informed employees."
A positive culture is an environment that nurtures capable, dedicated and informed employees.

microscope

Electrophoresis

Centrifugation

Glucose oxidase method
Glucose oxidase method is one of the most common methods of measuring blood glucose.

Planning

______ refers to blood that cannot be physically seen ("hidden").
Occult blood

manager
The manager is responsible for evaluating alternatives and making decisions that bring the greatest benefit to the laboratory.

Principle

followings
